subject: Last check — should I stop pursuing this pilot?
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@tideway.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call notes + pilot suggestion

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute call and a simple next-steps proposal so we don’t lose momentum: 

What we discussed:
- Primary goal: reduce inference cost by ~45% on your batch embedding workload while keeping P95 latency <= 120ms.
- Constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data, US-only region, vendor security checklist required.
- Success metric: cost per 1M tokens and embedding recall delta <= 1.5% vs current baseline.

Proposal (minimal pilot):
1) 2-week pilot on a subset (10M tokens/month) using a quantized model variant we talked about.
2) Redwood provides a temporary dedicated pool and a short eval plan we’ll run with your test prompts.
3) Weekly sync (15 min) to review results; final readout and recommendation.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20261020.txt (raw notes), redwood-proposal-TidewayAI-v2.pdf (pilot scope + high-level pricing).

Questions for you:
- Does the proposed pilot scope look reasonable from your side?
- Any procurement or security steps I should route the materials to now?
- If timing looks good, can we schedule the kick-off the week of Nov 2? I’ve included a Calendly link in the PDF.

If you prefer, I can loop in our security lead for the checklist review — let me know and I’ll add them.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-proposal-TidewayAI-v2.pdf (proposal, 14 pages)

Hi Olivia —

Just bumping this in case the attachments didn’t make it through or the timing needs adjusting. We’re holding a small slot for early-Nov pilots and it would be great to reserve it if Tideway is still interested.

Quick answers to common questions we hear:
- Security: we can provide an export of our vendor questionnaire and SOC 2 report by next business day.
- Budget: pilot pricing in the PDF is meant to be conservative — there’s room to scale down scope.

Would you prefer I send the proposal to someone in procurement/security directly? Happy to make introductions.

Thanks,
Jordan

Subject: Final check — should I close the file?

Hi Olivia —

Last note from me on this thread — I don’t want to clutter your inbox. I haven’t heard back on the pilot proposal and next steps, so I wanted to give you two quick options and then I’ll archive this pursuit on my side: 

A) Still interested — reply with a preferred week in Nov/Dec and I’ll get the kickoff scheduled and loop in our security lead.
B) Not a fit / deprioritized — reply “Close file” and I’ll archive the opportunity and stop outreach.

Either way is totally fine — I just want to make sure I’m not chasing something that’s no longer a priority for Tideway.

If you’d like a shorter note for procurement/security folks, I can send a one-page summary to the appropriate contact — just say the word.

Thanks for the time you’ve already put in, and I hope we’ll cross paths again.

Best regards,
Jordan Blake
